title: RAD6 Affects Tumorigenesis of Esophageal Squamous Cell Carcinoma by Regulating Histone Ubiquitination
author: Deng, Li, et al.
materials: As previously described, immunohistochemistry was conducted to examine protein expression in tissues [36]. Briefly, ESCC tissues and adjacent normal tissues were cut into 3 μm paraffin sections and incubated with mouse monoclonal antibodies RAD6 (1:200, Abcam, USA) at 4 °C overnight. The sections were probed with goat anti-mouse IgG-HRP secondary antibodies (1:2000, Southern Biotech, USA) for 1.5 h at room temperature and stained with DAB reagent, and finally counterstained with hematoxylin. The intensity was scored as follows: 0, negative; 1, weak; 2, moderate and 3, strong. The frequency of positive eckks was defined as follows: 0, less than 5%; 1, 5% to 25%; 2, 26% to 50%; 3, 51–75%; 4, more than 75%.

Human-derived RAD6A and RAD6B and control plasmids acquired from addgene were cloned into the pLVX-IRES-Puro-3 × Flag vector. The lentivirus (Hanheng Biotechnology, Shanghai, China) was loaded with shRNA targeting RAD6A and RAD6B and the corresponding controls (Sigma-Aldrich, Shanghai, China). KYSE180 and TE8 cells were then infected with the packaged lentivirus and stable expression strains were screened with 5 μg/ml puromycin. steps.title: Extract RAD6 data with Ualcan
steps.instruction: Open the Ualcan web portal (http://ualcan.path.uab.edu/index.html) and retrieve gene expression levels and prognosis information for RAD6A and RAD6B from the TCGA‑ESCA dataset.

steps.title: Culture ESCC cell lines
steps.instruction: Obtain six esophageal squamous cell carcinoma lines (SHEE, KYSE180, TE8, KYSE150, KYSE410, KYSE520) from ATCC and maintain them in RPMI‑1640 medium supplemented with 10 % fetal bovine serum and 1 % antibiotics, incubating at 37 °C in a humidified 5 % CO₂ incubator.

steps.title: Prepare tissue sections for IHC
steps.instruction: Cut ESCC tumor and adjacent normal tissues into 3 µm paraffin sections and place them on glass slides.

steps.title: Immunohistochemical staining of RAD6
steps.instruction: Incubate the sections with mouse monoclonal anti‑RAD6 antibody (1:200, Abcam, USA) at 4 °C overnight. Then apply goat anti‑mouse IgG‑HRP secondary antibody (1:2000, Southern Biotech, USA) for 1.5 h at room temperature, develop with DAB reagent, and counterstain with hematoxylin. Score intensity (0‑3) and frequency (0‑4) as described.

substeps.instruction: Secondary antibody incubation: 1:2000 dilution, 1.5 h at RT.

steps.title: Package lentivirus and transduce cells
steps.instruction: Clone human RAD6A, RAD6B and control plasmids from Addgene into the pLVX‑IRES‑Puro‑3×Flag vector, produce lentivirus (Hanheng Biotechnology, Shanghai, China) carrying shRNAs targeting RAD6A/B (Sigma‑Aldrich, Shanghai, China) and corresponding controls, infect KYSE180 and TE8 cells, and select stable lines with 5 µg ml⁻¹ puromycin. Use the shRNA target sequences listed in Table 2.

steps.title: Perform Western blot analysis
steps.instruction: Lyse cells in Sigma‑Aldrich RIPA buffer with protease and phosphatase inhibitors, quantify protein with a KeyGEN BCA assay kit, load 50 µg protein per lane on SDS‑PAGE, transfer to a Sigma‑Aldrich PVDF membrane, incubate with the appropriate primary antibodies at 4 °C overnight, then with HRP‑conjugated secondary antibodies for 2 h, and visualize the bands.

substeps.instruction: Detect signals using appropriate chemiluminescent substrate.

steps.title: Analyze data statistically
steps.instruction: Process all experimental data with SPSS v23.0 (SPSS Inc., Chicago, USA); use chi‑square test to assess correlation between RAD6 and CCNB1, apply Student’s t‑test or one‑way ANOVA for comparisons between two or multiple groups, and consider P < 0.05 as statistically significant.
